body:
You might enjoy my short-fiction e-books … They’re more relevant now than ever: The Word of the Lord to Republicans, The Word of the Lord to Democrats, and The Word of the Lord to Evangelicals.

Or my newest non-fiction, Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road? (Christian Identity in a Multi-Faith World). Also available as an audiobook.

Or a short-fiction sequel to Cross the Road, called The Girl with the Dove Tattoo.
